command:
set -u
base=/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
in="$base/incoming"
out="$base/normalized"
mkdir -p "$out"
status=0
tab=$(printf '\t')
{
  IFS="$tab" read -r hdr_name hdr_enc || exit 1
  while IFS="$tab" read -r name enc; do
    [ -n "$name" ] || continue
    case "$name" in */*|'..') printf 'REJECTED unsafe filename: %s\n' "$name" >&2; status=1; continue;; esac
    src="$in/$name"
    dst="$out/$name"
    tmp_dec="$out/.${name}.decoded.$$"
    tmp_lf="$out/.${name}.lf.$$"
    rm -f "$tmp_dec" "$tmp_lf"
    if [ ! -f "$src" ]; then
      printf 'ERROR missing input: %s\n' "$name" >&2
      status=1
      continue
    fi
    if ! iconv -f "$enc" -t UTF-8 "$src" > "$tmp_dec"; then
      printf 'UNDECODABLE %s declared=%s; no output published\n' "$name" "$enc" >&2
      rm -f "$tmp_dec" "$tmp_lf"
      status=1
      continue
    fi
    if ! tr -d '\r' < "$tmp_dec" > "$tmp_lf"; then
      printf 'ERROR line-ending normalization failed: %s\n' "$name" >&2
      rm -f "$tmp_dec" "$tmp_lf"
      status=1
      continue
    fi
    if ! iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$tmp_lf" > /dev/null; then
      printf 'ERROR post-conversion UTF-8 validation failed: %s\n' "$name" >&2
      rm -f "$tmp_dec" "$tmp_lf"
      status=1
      continue
    fi
    chmod 0644 "$tmp_lf"
    mv -f "$tmp_lf" "$dst"
    rm -f "$tmp_dec"
    printf 'PUBLISHED %s declared=%s\n' "$name" "$enc"
  done
} < "$base/encodings.tsv"
find "$out" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.*' -delete
exit "$status"
